description: This file implements a logging mechanism that integrates with the systemd journal (via sd_journal_print). It defines functions for creating a journal logger and for logging messages with severity level translations to syslog. The file includes configuration options for log prefixing and interfaces with external journal printing functions.

methods.name: void logger_journal_new(logger_t * self)
methods.description: Initializes a new journal logger, setting its logging function and clearing the logger structure.

methods.name: void logger_journal_log(logger_t * self,logger_msg_t * msg)
methods.description: Logs a message to the systemd journal, translating internal severity levels to syslog severity and formatting the message accordingly.
